name: qa-property-based
description: Property-based testing libraries for the QuickCheck-derived family: 4 skills (hypothesis-testing for Python, fast-check-testing for JS/TS, proptest-testing for Rust, jqwik-testing for JVM), each shipping authoring + run + shrinking + CI integration, with a per-language decision table in the README. Plus 2 agents: property-based-test-author (encodes one invariant per test) and vacuous-property-critic (flags assume-heavy or always-true properties).
